KEENEYE.name: Keen Eye
KEENEYE.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering accuracy.

SNIPER.name: Sniper
SNIPER.desc: Powers up moves if they become critical hits.

POISONPOINT.name: Poison Point
POISONPOINT.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

SWARM.name: Swarm
SWARM.desc: Powers up Bug-type moves in a pinch.

SPEEDBOOST.name: Speed Boost
SPEEDBOOST.desc: Its Speed stat is gradually boosted.

STURDY.name: Sturdy
STURDY.desc: It cannot be knocked out with one hit.

WEAKARMOR.name: Weak Armor
WEAKARMOR.desc: Physical attacks lower Defense and raise Speed.

MAGMAARMOR.name: Magma Armor
MAGMAARMOR.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

ANGERPOINT.name: Anger Point
ANGERPOINT.desc: Maxes Attack after taking a critical hit.

FLASHFIRE.name: Flash Fire
FLASHFIRE.desc: It powers up Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.

FLAMEBODY.name: Flame Body
FLAMEBODY.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

INFILTRATOR.name: Infiltrator
INFILTRATOR.desc: Passes through the foe's barrier and strikes.

COLORCHANGE.name: Color Change
COLORCHANGE.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the foe's move.

PROTEAN.name: Protean
PROTEAN.desc: It changes type to that of the move it's about to use.

SAPSIPPER.name: Sap Sipper
SAPSIPPER.desc: Boosts Attack when hit by a Grass-type move.

HYDRATION.name: Hydration
HYDRATION.desc: Heals status problems if it is raining.

GOOEY.name: Gooey
GOOEY.desc: Contact with it lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

PRESSURE.name: Pressure
PRESSURE.desc: The Pokémon raises the foe's PP usage.

FRISK.name: Frisk
FRISK.desc: The Pokémon can check a foe's held item.

IRONFIST.name: Iron Fist
IRONFIST.desc: Boosts the power of punching moves.

KLUTZ.name: Klutz
KLUTZ.desc: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

NOGUARD.name: No Guard
NOGUARD.desc: Ensures attacks by or against the Pokémon land.

MERCILESS.name: Merciless
MERCILESS.desc: Its attacks are critical hits when it is poisoned.

LIMBER.name: Limber
LIMBER.desc: The Pokémon is protected from paralysis.

REGENERATOR.name: Regenerator
REGENERATOR.desc: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

SYNCHRONIZE.name: Synchronize
SYNCHRONIZE.desc: Passes a burn, poison, or paralysis to the foe.

INNERFOCUS.name: Inner Focus
INNERFOCUS.desc: The Pokémon is protected from flinching.

MAGICGUARD.name: Magic Guard
MAGICGUARD.desc: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

SHIELDSDOWN.name: Shields Down
SHIELDSDOWN.desc: Its shell breaks if its HP becomes half or less.

STENCH.name: Stench
STENCH.desc: The stench may cause the target to flinch.

AFTERMATH.name: Aftermath
AFTERMATH.desc: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit.

SWIFTSWIM.name: Swift Swim
SWIFTSWIM.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in rain.

STRONGJAW.name: Strong Jaw
STRONGJAW.desc: Boosts the power of biting moves.

ROCKHEAD.name: Rock Head
ROCKHEAD.desc: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

LEAFGUARD.name: Leaf Guard
LEAFGUARD.desc: Prevents problems with status in sunny weather.

CONTRARY.name: Contrary
CONTRARY.desc: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

OVERGROW.name: Overgrow
OVERGROW.desc: Powers up Grass-type moves in a pinch.

STATIC.name: Static
STATIC.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may cause paralysis.

LIGHTNINGROD.name: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNINGROD.desc: Draws in all Electric-type moves to up Sp. Attack.

HUSTLE.name: Hustle
HUSTLE.desc: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.

SERENEGRACE.name: Serene Grace
SERENEGRACE.desc: Boosts the likelihood of added effects appearing.

SUPERLUCK.name: Super Luck
SUPERLUCK.desc: Heightens the critical-hit ratios of moves.

TELEPATHY.name: Telepathy
TELEPATHY.desc: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.

ANALYTIC.name: Analytic
ANALYTIC.desc: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

TRACE.name: Trace
TRACE.desc: The Pokémon copies a foe's Ability.

DOWNLOAD.name: Download
DOWNLOAD.desc: Adjusts power according to a foe's defenses.

STANCECHANGE.name: Stance Change
STANCECHANGE.desc: Changes between Blade and Shield Forme with attacks.

TRUANT.name: Truant
TRUANT.desc: Pokémon can't attack on consecutive turns.

DANCER.name: Dancer
DANCER.desc: Repeats another Pokémon's dance move immediately.

NATURALCURE.name: Natural Cure
NATURALCURE.desc: All status problems heal when it switches out.

HARVEST.name: Harvest
HARVEST.desc: May create another Berry after one is used.

LEVITATE.name: Levitate
LEVITATE.desc: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

HYPERCUTTER.name: Hyper Cutter
HYPERCUTTER.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering Attack stat.

SHELLARMOR.name: Shell Armor
SHELLARMOR.desc: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

ADAPTABILITY.name: Adaptability
ADAPTABILITY.desc: Powers up moves of the same type.

QUICKFEET.name: Quick Feet
QUICKFEET.desc: Boosts Speed if there is a status problem.

GUTS.name: Guts
GUTS.desc: Boosts Attack if there is a status problem.

UNNERVE.name: Unnerve
UNNERVE.desc: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.

VITALSPIRIT.name: Vital Spirit
VITALSPIRIT.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from falling asleep.

BLAZE.name: Blaze
BLAZE.desc: Powers up Fire-type moves in a pinch.

MAGICIAN.name: Magician
MAGICIAN.desc: Steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits.

AERIALACE.name: Aerial Ace
AERIALACE.desc: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

AGILITY.name: Agility
AGILITY.desc: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.

AIRCUTTER.name: Air Cutter
AIRCUTTER.desc: The user launches razor-like wind to slash the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

ASSURANCE.name: Assurance
ASSURANCE.desc: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

ATTRACT.name: Attract
ATTRACT.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

CONFIDE.name: Confide
CONFIDE.desc: The user tells the target a secret. The target loses focus and its Sp. Atk stat is lowered.

DEFOG.name: Defog
DEFOG.desc: A strong wind blows away the foe's obstacles such as Light Screen. It also lowers their evasion.

DOUBLETEAM.name: Double Team
DOUBLETEAM.desc: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

DRILLPECK.name: Drill Peck
DRILLPECK.desc: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

DRILLRUN.name: Drill Run
DRILLRUN.desc: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

ECHOEDVOICE.name: Echoed Voice
ECHOEDVOICE.desc: The user attacks the foe with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, it does greater damage.

FACADE.name: Facade
FACADE.desc: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or has paralysis.

FALSESWIPE.name: False Swipe
FALSESWIPE.desc: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

FLY.name: Fly
FLY.desc: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.

FOCUSENERGY.name: Focus Energy
FOCUSENERGY.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

FRUSTRATION.name: Frustration
FRUSTRATION.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

FURYATTACK.name: Fury Attack
FURYATTACK.desc: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

GIGAIMPACT.name: Giga Impact
GIGAIMPACT.desc: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

GROWL.name: Growl
GROWL.desc: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The foe's Attack stat is lowered.

HEATWAVE.name: Heat Wave
HEATWAVE.desc: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on the opposing team. It may also leave targets with a burn.

HIDDENPOWER.name: Hidden Power
HIDDENPOWER.desc: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

HYPERBEAM.name: Hyper Beam
HYPERBEAM.desc: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

LASERFOCUS.name: Laser Focus
LASERFOCUS.desc: The user focuses intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

LEER.name: Leer
LEER.desc: The user gains an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target's Defense stat is reduced.

MIRRORMOVE.name: Mirror Move
MIRRORMOVE.desc: The user counters the target by mimicking the target's last move.

MUDSLAP.name: Mud-Slap
MUDSLAP.desc: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

OMINOUSWIND.name: Ominous Wind
OMINOUSWIND.desc: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

PECK.name: Peck
PECK.desc: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

PLUCK.name: Pluck
PLUCK.desc: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

PROTECT.name: Protect
PROTECT.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

PURSUIT.name: Pursuit
PURSUIT.desc: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a target that is switching out of battle.

RAINDANCE.name: Rain Dance
RAINDANCE.desc: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

REST.name: Rest
REST.desc: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user's HP and heals any status problem.

RETURN.name: Return
RETURN.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

ROOST.name: Roost
ROOST.desc: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.

ROUND.name: Round
ROUND.desc: The user attacks with a song. Others can join in the Round and make the attack do greater damage.

SECRETPOWER.name: Secret Power
SECRETPOWER.desc: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user's environment.

SKYATTACK.name: Sky Attack
SKYATTACK.desc: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. It may also make the target flinch.

SLEEPTALK.name: Sleep Talk
SLEEPTALK.desc: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

SNORE.name: Snore
SNORE.desc: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

STEELWING.name: Steel Wing
STEELWING.desc: The target is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user's Defense stat.

SUBSTITUTE.name: Substitute
SUBSTITUTE.desc: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user's decoy.

SUNNYDAY.name: Sunny Day
SUNNYDAY.desc: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

SWAGGER.name: Swagger
SWAGGER.desc: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, it also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

SWIFT.name: Swift
SWIFT.desc: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.

TAILWIND.name: Tailwind
TAILWIND.desc: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for four turns.

THIEF.name: Thief
THIEF.desc: The user attacks and steals the foe's held item simultaneously. It can't steal if the user holds an item.

THROATCHOP.name: Throat Chop
THROATCHOP.desc: The user attacks the target's throat. The target cannot use sound-based moves for two turns.

TOXIC.name: Toxic
TOXIC.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

TWISTER.name: Twister
TWISTER.desc: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the opposing team. It may also make targets flinch.

UPROAR.name: Uproar
UPROAR.desc: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

UTURN.name: U-turn
UTURN.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

WORKUP.name: Work Up
WORKUP.desc: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

AQUATAIL.name: Aqua Tail
AQUATAIL.desc: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

BATONPASS.name: Baton Pass
BATONPASS.desc: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

BUGBITE.name: Bug Bite
BUGBITE.desc: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

BULLDOZE.name: Bulldoze
BULLDOZE.desc: The user strikes everything around it by stomping on the ground. It reduces hit Pokémon's Speed.

CUT.name: Cut
CUT.desc: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

DEFENSECURL.name: Defense Curl
DEFENSECURL.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

DOUBLEEDGE.name: Double-Edge
DOUBLEEDGE.desc: A reckless, life-risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.

EARTHQUAKE.name: Earthquake
EARTHQUAKE.desc: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

ENDEAVOR.name: Endeavor
ENDEAVOR.desc: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

GYROBALL.name: Gyro Ball
GYROBALL.desc: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

INFESTATION.name: Infestation
INFESTATION.desc: The target is infested and unable to flee for four to five turns.

IRONDEFENSE.name: Iron Defense
IRONDEFENSE.desc: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

IRONTAIL.name: Iron Tail
IRONTAIL.desc: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

MEGAHORN.name: Megahorn
MEGAHORN.desc: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

PAYBACK.name: Payback
PAYBACK.desc: If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

POISONJAB.name: Poison Jab
POISONJAB.desc: The target is stabbed with a tentacle or arm seeped with poison. It may also poison the target.

POISONSTING.name: Poison Sting
POISONSTING.desc: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

POISONTAIL.name: Poison Tail
POISONTAIL.desc: The user hits the target with its tail. It may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

ROCKCLIMB.name: Rock Climb
ROCKCLIMB.desc: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. It may also confuse the target.

ROCKSLIDE.name: Rock Slide
ROCKSLIDE.desc: Large boulders are hurled at the foes to inflict damage. It may also make the targets flinch.

ROCKSMASH.name: Rock Smash
ROCKSMASH.desc: The user attacks with a punch that can shatter a rock. It may also lower the foe's Defense stat.

ROCKTOMB.name: Rock Tomb
ROCKTOMB.desc: Boulders are hurled at the target. It also lowers the target's Speed by preventing its movement.

ROLLOUT.name: Rollout
ROLLOUT.desc: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

SCREECH.name: Screech
SCREECH.desc: An earsplitting screech harshly reduces the target's Defense stat.

SIGNALBEAM.name: Signal Beam
SIGNALBEAM.desc: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.

SLUDGEBOMB.name: Sludge Bomb
SLUDGEBOMB.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

SMARTSTRIKE.name: Smart Strike
SMARTSTRIKE.desc: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

SNATCH.name: Snatch
SNATCH.desc: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat-changing move the foe attempts to use.

SOLARBEAM.name: Solar Beam
SOLARBEAM.desc: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

STEAMROLLER.name: Steamroller
STEAMROLLER.desc: The user crushes its foes by rolling over them. This attack may make the target flinch.

STOMPINGTANTRUM.name: Stomping Tantrum
STOMPINGTANTRUM.desc: The user attacks driven by frustration. Power increases if the user's previous move failed.

STRENGTH.name: Strength
STRENGTH.desc: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move heavy boulders.

STRUGGLEBUG.name: Struggle Bug
STRUGGLEBUG.desc: While resisting, the user attacks the opposing Pokémon. The targets' Sp. Atk stat is reduced.

SUPERPOWER.name: Superpower
SUPERPOWER.desc: The user attacks the target with great power. However, it also lowers the user's Attack and Defense.

SWORDSDANCE.name: Swords Dance
SWORDSDANCE.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

VENOMDRENCH.name: Venom Drench
VENOMDRENCH.desc: Foes are drenched in an odd liquid that lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed of poisoned Pokémon.

VENOSHOCK.name: Venoshock
VENOSHOCK.desc: The user drenches the foe in a special poisonous liquid. Its power doubles if the target is poisoned.

XSCISSOR.name: X-Scissor
XSCISSOR.desc: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

AIRSLASH.name: Air Slash
AIRSLASH.desc: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

AUTOTOMIZE.name: Autotomize
AUTOTOMIZE.desc: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

BRAVEBIRD.name: Brave Bird
BRAVEBIRD.desc: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

CURSE.name: Curse
CURSE.desc: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.

DARKPULSE.name: Dark Pulse
DARKPULSE.desc: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

ENDURE.name: Endure
ENDURE.desc: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

FEINT.name: Feint
FEINT.desc: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

FLASH.name: Flash
FLASH.desc: The user flashes a light that cuts the target's accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

FLASHCANNON.name: Flash Cannon
FLASHCANNON.desc: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

FURYCUTTER.name: Fury Cutter
FURYCUTTER.desc: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

GUARDSWAP.name: Guard Swap
GUARDSWAP.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target.

ICYWIND.name: Icy Wind
ICYWIND.desc: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the targets' Speed stat.

IRONHEAD.name: Iron Head
IRONHEAD.desc: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

METALCLAW.name: Metal Claw
METALCLAW.desc: The target is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user's Attack stat.

METALSOUND.name: Metal Sound
METALSOUND.desc: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

NIGHTSLASH.name: Night Slash
NIGHTSLASH.desc: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

ROAR.name: Roar
ROAR.desc: The target is scared off and replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

SANDATTACK.name: Sand Attack
SANDATTACK.desc: Sand is hurled in the target's face, reducing its accuracy.

SANDSTORM.name: Sandstorm
SANDSTORM.desc: Summons a five-turn sandstorm to hurt all combatants except the Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

SKYDROP.name: Sky Drop
SKYDROP.desc: The user takes the foe into the sky, then drops it on the next turn. The foe cannot attack while airborne.

SLASH.name: Slash
SLASH.desc: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

SPIKES.name: Spikes
SPIKES.desc: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe's feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

STEALTHROCK.name: Stealth Rock
STEALTHROCK.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

TAUNT.name: Taunt
TAUNT.desc: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

TORMENT.name: Torment
TORMENT.desc: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

TOXICSPIKES.name: Toxic Spikes
TOXICSPIKES.desc: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe's feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

WHIRLWIND.name: Whirlwind
WHIRLWIND.desc: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

AFTERYOU.name: After You
AFTERYOU.desc: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

AMNESIA.name: Amnesia
AMNESIA.desc: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

EARTHPOWER.name: Earth Power
EARTHPOWER.desc: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

EMBER.name: Ember
EMBER.desc: The target is attacked with small flames. It may also leave the target with a burn.

ERUPTION.name: Eruption
ERUPTION.desc: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

EXPLOSION.name: Explosion
EXPLOSION.desc: The user explodes to inflict damage on those around it. The user faints upon using this move.

FIREBLAST.name: Fire Blast
FIREBLAST.desc: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

FISSURE.name: Fissure
FISSURE.desc: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

FLAMEBURST.name: Flame Burst
FLAMEBURST.desc: The user attacks the foe with a bursting flame. It also damages Pokémon next to the target.

FLAMECHARGE.name: Flame Charge
FLAMECHARGE.desc: The user cloaks itself in flame and attacks. Building up more power, it raises the user's Speed stat.

FLAMETHROWER.name: Flamethrower
FLAMETHROWER.desc: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.

LAVAPLUME.name: Lava Plume
LAVAPLUME.desc: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may leave targets with a burn.

MAGNITUDE.name: Magnitude
MAGNITUDE.desc: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone around the user. Its power varies.

NATUREPOWER.name: Nature Power
NATUREPOWER.desc: An attack that makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

OVERHEAT.name: Overheat
OVERHEAT.desc: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

ROCKPOLISH.name: Rock Polish
ROCKPOLISH.desc: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

STONEEDGE.name: Stone Edge
STONEEDGE.desc: The user stabs the foe with sharpened stones from below. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

TACKLE.name: Tackle
TACKLE.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

TAKEDOWN.name: Take Down
TAKEDOWN.desc: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.

WILLOWISP.name: Will-O-Wisp
WILLOWISP.desc: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.

YAWN.name: Yawn
YAWN.desc: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

ALLYSWITCH.name: Ally Switch
ALLYSWITCH.desc: The user teleports using a strange power and switches its place with one of its allies.

CALMMIND.name: Calm Mind
CALMMIND.desc: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

CONFUSERAY.name: Confuse Ray
CONFUSERAY.desc: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

DREAMEATER.name: Dream Eater
DREAMEATER.desc: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user's HP.

EMBARGO.name: Embargo
EMBARGO.desc: It prevents the target from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

ENERGYBALL.name: Energy Ball
ENERGYBALL.desc: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

HEX.name: Hex
HEX.desc: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status problems.

INCINERATE.name: Incinerate
INCINERATE.desc: The user attacks the foe with fire. The target's held Berry becomes burnt up and unusable.

PAINSPLIT.name: Pain Split
PAINSPLIT.desc: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

PSYCHIC.name: Psychic
PSYCHIC.desc: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the target's Sp. Def stat.

PSYCHUP.name: Psych Up
PSYCHUP.desc: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

SAFEGUARD.name: Safeguard
SAFEGUARD.desc: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

SHADOWBALL.name: Shadow Ball
SHADOWBALL.desc: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

SHOCKWAVE.name: Shock Wave
SHOCKWAVE.desc: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

SMOG.name: Smog
SMOG.desc: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.

SPITE.name: Spite
SPITE.desc: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

TELEKINESIS.name: Telekinesis
TELEKINESIS.desc: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

TELEPORT.name: Teleport
TELEPORT.desc: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It can also warp to the last Pokémon Center visited.

TRICK.name: Trick
TRICK.desc: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

TRICKROOM.name: Trick Room
TRICKROOM.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

ANCIENTPOWER.name: Ancient Power
ANCIENTPOWER.desc: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user's stats at once.

ASTONISH.name: Astonish
ASTONISH.desc: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.

BIND.name: Bind
BIND.desc: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for four to five turns.

BLIZZARD.name: Blizzard
BLIZZARD.desc: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

BRICKBREAK.name: Brick Break
BRICKBREAK.desc: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

CAMOUFLAGE.name: Camouflage
CAMOUFLAGE.desc: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.

CHARGEBEAM.name: Charge Beam
CHARGEBEAM.desc: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

DIG.name: Dig
DIG.desc: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

DISABLE.name: Disable
DISABLE.desc: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

DIZZYPUNCH.name: Dizzy Punch
DIZZYPUNCH.desc: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.

DRAINPUNCH.name: Drain Punch
DRAINPUNCH.desc: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

FAKEOUT.name: Fake Out
FAKEOUT.desc: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

FEINTATTACK.name: Feint Attack
FEINTATTACK.desc: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

FIREPUNCH.name: Fire Punch
FIREPUNCH.desc: The target is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

FLING.name: Fling
FLING.desc: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

FOCUSPUNCH.name: Focus Punch
FOCUSPUNCH.desc: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

FOULPLAY.name: Foul Play
FOULPLAY.desc: The user turns the foe's power against it. It does more damage the higher the target's Attack stat.

FURYSWIPES.name: Fury Swipes
FURYSWIPES.desc: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

GRASSKNOT.name: Grass Knot
GRASSKNOT.desc: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the damage.

HONECLAWS.name: Hone Claws
HONECLAWS.desc: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

ICEBEAM.name: Ice Beam
ICEBEAM.desc: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

ICEPUNCH.name: Ice Punch
ICEPUNCH.desc: The target is punched with an icy fist. It may also leave the target frozen.

KNOCKOFF.name: Knock Off
KNOCKOFF.desc: The user slaps down the target's held item, preventing that item from being used in the battle.

LASTRESORT.name: Last Resort
LASTRESORT.desc: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

LICK.name: Lick
LICK.desc: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

LOWKICK.name: Low Kick
LOWKICK.desc: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

MAGICCOAT.name: Magic Coat
MAGICCOAT.desc: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

METRONOME.name: Metronome
METRONOME.desc: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

NASTYPLOT.name: Nasty Plot
NASTYPLOT.desc: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk.

POWERUPPUNCH.name: Power-Up Punch
POWERUPPUNCH.desc: Striking opponents repeatedly makes the user's fists harder, raising the user's Attack stat.

PSYBEAM.name: Psybeam
PSYBEAM.desc: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also cause confusion.

RECOVER.name: Recover
RECOVER.desc: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

RECYCLE.name: Recycle
RECYCLE.desc: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

RETALIATE.name: Retaliate
RETALIATE.desc: Gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the last turn, this attack's damage increases.

ROLEPLAY.name: Role Play
ROLEPLAY.desc: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.

SCRATCH.name: Scratch
SCRATCH.desc: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

SHADOWCLAW.name: Shadow Claw
SHADOWCLAW.desc: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

SHADOWSNEAK.name: Shadow Sneak
SHADOWSNEAK.desc: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

SKILLSWAP.name: Skill Swap
SKILLSWAP.desc: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

SUCKERPUNCH.name: Sucker Punch
SUCKERPUNCH.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the target is not readying an attack, however.

SYNCHRONOISE.name: Synchronoise
SYNCHRONOISE.desc: Using an odd shock wave, the user damages any Pokémon of the same type as the user.

TAILWHIP.name: Tail Whip
TAILWHIP.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.

THUNDER.name: Thunder
THUNDER.desc: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

THUNDERBOLT.name: Thunderbolt
THUNDERBOLT.desc: A strong electric blast is loosed at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

THUNDERPUNCH.name: Thunder Punch
THUNDERPUNCH.desc: The target is punched with an electrified fist. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

THUNDERWAVE.name: Thunder Wave
THUNDERWAVE.desc: A weak electric charge is launched at the target. It causes paralysis if it hits.

WATERPULSE.name: Water Pulse
WATERPULSE.desc: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the target.

WONDERROOM.name: Wonder Room
WONDERROOM.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for 5 turns.

ABSORB.name: Absorb
ABSORB.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

BIDE.name: Bide
BIDE.desc: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

BODYSLAM.name: Body Slam
BODYSLAM.desc: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may leave the target with paralysis.

BRUTALSWING.name: Brutal Swing
BRUTALSWING.desc: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

BUBBLE.name: Bubble
BUBBLE.desc: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing team. It may also lower the targets' Speed stats.

DRACOMETEOR.name: Draco Meteor
DRACOMETEOR.desc: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly reduces the user's Sp. Atk stat.

DRAGONBREATH.name: Dragon Breath
DRAGONBREATH.desc: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

DRAGONPULSE.name: Dragon Pulse
DRAGONPULSE.desc: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

DRAGONTAIL.name: Dragon Tail
DRAGONTAIL.desc: The user knocks away the target and drags out another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.

FLAIL.name: Flail
FLAIL.desc: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

FOCUSBLAST.name: Focus Blast
FOCUSBLAST.desc: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

HAIL.name: Hail
HAIL.desc: The user summons a hail storm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

MUDDYWATER.name: Muddy Water
MUDDYWATER.desc: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at the opposing team. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

OUTRAGE.name: Outrage
OUTRAGE.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

POWERWHIP.name: Power Whip
POWERWHIP.desc: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the target.

SLUDGEWAVE.name: Sludge Wave
SLUDGEWAVE.desc: It swamps the area around the user with a giant sludge wave. It may also poison those hit.

FORESIGHT.name: Foresight
FORESIGHT.desc: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any kind of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

FUTURESIGHT.name: Future Sight
FUTURESIGHT.desc: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

GRAVITY.name: Gravity
GRAVITY.desc: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

MEANLOOK.name: Mean Look
MEANLOOK.desc: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

NIGHTSHADE.name: Night Shade
NIGHTSHADE.desc: The user makes the foe see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user's level.

SHADOWPUNCH.name: Shadow Punch
SHADOWPUNCH.desc: The user throws a punch from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.

BLOCK.name: Block
BLOCK.desc: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

DYNAMICPUNCH.name: Dynamic Punch
DYNAMICPUNCH.desc: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. It confuses the target if it hits.

HAMMERARM.name: Hammer Arm
HAMMERARM.desc: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.

HEAVYSLAM.name: Heavy Slam
HEAVYSLAM.desc: The user slams into the foe with its heavy body. The heavier the user, the greater the damage.

HIGHHORSEPOWER.name: High Horsepower
HIGHHORSEPOWER.desc: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

LOWSWEEP.name: Low Sweep
LOWSWEEP.desc: The user attacks the target's legs swiftly, reducing the target's Speed stat.

MEGAPUNCH.name: Mega Punch
MEGAPUNCH.desc: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

PHANTOMFORCE.name: Phantom Force
PHANTOMFORCE.desc: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes on the next turn. Hits through protections.

POUND.name: Pound
POUND.desc: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

ZENHEADBUTT.name: Zen Headbutt
ZENHEADBUTT.desc: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

BANEFULBUNKER.name: Baneful Bunker
BANEFULBUNKER.desc: Protects the user from attacks. Also poisons any attacker that makes contact with the user.

BITE.name: Bite
BITE.desc: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.

COVET.name: Covet
COVET.desc: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

FROSTBREATH.name: Frost Breath
FROSTBREATH.desc: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

GASTROACID.name: Gastro Acid
GASTROACID.desc: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid negates the effect of the target's Ability.

GUNKSHOT.name: Gunk Shot
GUNKSHOT.desc: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. It may also poison the target.

LIGHTSCREEN.name: Light Screen
LIGHTSCREEN.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.

LIQUIDATION.name: Liquidation
LIQUIDATION.desc: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. May lower the target's Defense.

PINMISSILE.name: Pin Missile
PINMISSILE.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

SCALD.name: Scald
SCALD.desc: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. It may also leave the target with a burn.

SMACKDOWN.name: Smack Down
SMACKDOWN.desc: The user throws a stone or projectile to attack. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when hit.

SPIKECANNON.name: Spike Cannon
SPIKECANNON.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

SURF.name: Surf
SURF.desc: It swamps the area around the user with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

WIDEGUARD.name: Wide Guard
WIDEGUARD.desc: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for a turn. May fail if used in succession.

CONFUSION.name: Confusion
CONFUSION.desc: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the target confused.

DAZZLINGGLEAM.name: Dazzling Gleam
DAZZLINGGLEAM.desc: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

KINESIS.name: Kinesis
KINESIS.desc: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. It lowers the target's accuracy.

MAGICROOM.name: Magic Room
MAGICROOM.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

MEGAKICK.name: Mega Kick
MEGAKICK.desc: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

MIRACLEEYE.name: Miracle Eye
MIRACLEEYE.desc: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

MORNINGSUN.name: Morning Sun
MORNINGSUN.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

PSYCHOCUT.name: Psycho Cut
PSYCHOCUT.desc: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

PSYSHOCK.name: Psyshock
PSYSHOCK.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

REFLECT.name: Reflect
REFLECT.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

ACROBATICS.name: Acrobatics
ACROBATICS.desc: The user nimbly strikes the foe. This attack does more damage if the user is not holding an item.

COSMICPOWER.name: Cosmic Power
COSMICPOWER.desc: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

MAGNETRISE.name: Magnet Rise
MAGNETRISE.desc: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

POWERGEM.name: Power Gem
POWERGEM.desc: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

SELFDESTRUCT.name: Self-Destruct
SELFDESTRUCT.desc: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.

SHELLSMASH.name: Shell Smash
SHELLSMASH.desc: The user breaks its shell, lowering its defenses but sharply raising attacking and Speed stats.

ACIDSPRAY.name: Acid Spray
ACIDSPRAY.desc: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly reduces the target's Sp. Def stat.

BELCH.name: Belch
BELCH.desc: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

CLEARSMOG.name: Clear Smog
CLEARSMOG.desc: The user attacks by throwing a clump of special mud. All status changes are returned to normal.

DOUBLESLAP.name: Double Slap
DOUBLESLAP.desc: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

GIGADRAIN.name: Giga Drain
GIGADRAIN.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

POISONGAS.name: Poison Gas
POISONGAS.desc: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon. It may poison those hit.

SEEDBOMB.name: Seed Bomb
SEEDBOMB.desc: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

SLUDGE.name: Sludge
SLUDGE.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may also poison the target.

STOCKPILE.name: Stockpile
STOCKPILE.desc: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

SWALLOW.name: Swallow
SWALLOW.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

AQUAJET.name: Aqua Jet
AQUAJET.desc: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

BOUNCE.name: Bounce
BOUNCE.desc: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

BRINE.name: Brine
BRINE.desc: If the target's HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

BUBBLEBEAM.name: Bubble Beam
BUBBLEBEAM.desc: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. It may also lower its Speed stat.

DESTINYBOND.name: Destiny Bond
DESTINYBOND.desc: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.

DIVE.name: Dive
DIVE.desc: Diving on the first turn, the user rises and hits on the next turn. It can be used to dive in the ocean.

FELLSTINGER.name: Fell Stinger
FELLSTINGER.desc: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.

HARDEN.name: Harden
HARDEN.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

HAZE.name: Haze
HAZE.desc: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

HYDROPUMP.name: Hydro Pump
HYDROPUMP.desc: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

MINIMIZE.name: Minimize
MINIMIZE.desc: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

REVENGE.name: Revenge
REVENGE.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

SPITUP.name: Spit Up
SPITUP.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released all at once in an attack.

SUPERSONIC.name: Supersonic
SUPERSONIC.desc: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.

WATERFALL.name: Waterfall
WATERFALL.desc: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.

WATERGUN.name: Water Gun
WATERGUN.desc: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

CHARM.name: Charm
CHARM.desc: The user charmingly gazes at the foe, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.

CRUNCH.name: Crunch
CRUNCH.desc: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

DRAGONCLAW.name: Dragon Claw
DRAGONCLAW.desc: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws.

HEADSMASH.name: Head Smash
HEADSMASH.desc: The user attacks the foe with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. The user also takes terrible damage.

HORNDRILL.name: Horn Drill
HORNDRILL.desc: The user stabs the foe with a horn that rotates like a drill. If it hits, the target faints instantly.

HYPERVOICE.name: Hyper Voice
HYPERVOICE.desc: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

STOMP.name: Stomp
STOMP.desc: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.

THRASH.name: Thrash
THRASH.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

DUALCHOP.name: Dual Chop
DUALCHOP.desc: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

GROWTH.name: Growth
GROWTH.desc: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.

INGRAIN.name: Ingrain
INGRAIN.desc: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can't switch out.

LEAFAGE.name: Leafage
LEAFAGE.desc: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

LEAFBLADE.name: Leaf Blade
LEAFBLADE.desc: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by slashing. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

LEECHLIFE.name: Leech Life
LEECHLIFE.desc: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

PETALBLIZZARD.name: Petal Blizzard
PETALBLIZZARD.desc: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

RAZORLEAF.name: Razor Leaf
RAZORLEAF.desc: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the opposing team. Critical hits land more easily.

SOLARBLADE.name: Solar Blade
SOLARBLADE.desc: The user gathers light energy into a blade, attacking the target on the next turn.

SWEETSCENT.name: Sweet Scent
SWEETSCENT.desc: A sweet scent that lowers the foe's evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

SYNTHESIS.name: Synthesis
SYNTHESIS.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

WORRYSEED.name: Worry Seed
WORRYSEED.desc: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its Ability Insomnia.

ROCKTHROW.name: Rock Throw
ROCKTHROW.desc: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

AROMATHERAPY.name: Aromatherapy
AROMATHERAPY.desc: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user's party.

FRENZYPLANT.name: Frenzy Plant
FRENZYPLANT.desc: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.

GRASSPLEDGE.name: Grass Pledge
GRASSPLEDGE.desc: A column of grass hits the foes. When used with its water equivalent, it creates a vast swamp.

MAGICALLEAF.name: Magical Leaf
MAGICALLEAF.desc: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack will not miss.

NATURALGIFT.name: Natural Gift
NATURALGIFT.desc: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

PETALDANCE.name: Petal Dance
PETALDANCE.desc: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

POISONPOWDER.name: Poison Powder
POISONPOWDER.desc: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust on the target. It may poison the target.

ELECTROWEB.name: Electroweb
ELECTROWEB.desc: The user captures and attacks foes by using an electric net, which lowers their Speed stat.

HELPINGHAND.name: Helping Hand
HELPINGHAND.desc: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.

QUICKATTACK.name: Quick Attack
QUICKATTACK.desc: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

THUNDERSHOCK.name: Thunder Shock
THUNDERSHOCK.desc: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

VOLTSWITCH.name: Volt Switch
VOLTSWITCH.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

WILDCHARGE.name: Wild Charge
WILDCHARGE.desc: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its foe. It also damages the user a little.

BESTOW.name: Bestow
BESTOW.desc: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.

DRAININGKISS.name: Draining Kiss
DRAININGKISS.desc: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage dealt.

ENCORE.name: Encore
ENCORE.desc: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.

FAIRYWIND.name: Fairy Wind
FAIRYWIND.desc: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

FOLLOWME.name: Follow Me
FOLLOWME.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

HEALBELL.name: Heal Bell
HEALBELL.desc: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

MOONBLAST.name: Moonblast
MOONBLAST.desc: The user attacks by borrowing the power of the moon. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

SOFTBOILED.name: Soft-Boiled
SOFTBOILED.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. May also be used in the field to heal HP.

SWEETKISS.name: Sweet Kiss
SWEETKISS.desc: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

WISH.name: Wish
WISH.desc: One turn after this move is used, the target's HP is restored by half the user's maximum HP.

BOOMBURST.name: Boomburst
BOOMBURST.desc: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.

GUST.name: Gust
GUST.desc: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

HURRICANE.name: Hurricane
HURRICANE.desc: The user wraps its foe in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. It may also confuse the foe.

MOONLIGHT.name: Moonlight
MOONLIGHT.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

RAZORWIND.name: Razor Wind
RAZORWIND.desc: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

SUPERFANG.name: Super Fang
SUPERFANG.desc: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.

WINGATTACK.name: Wing Attack
WINGATTACK.desc: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

DISCHARGE.name: Discharge
DISCHARGE.desc: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike the area around the user. It may also cause paralysis.

ELECTRICTERRAIN.name: Electric Terrain
ELECTRICTERRAIN.desc: The user electrifies the ground for five turns. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

ELECTROBALL.name: Electro Ball
ELECTROBALL.desc: The user hurls an electric orb at the foe. It does more damage the faster the user is.

LOCKON.name: Lock-On
LOCKON.desc: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

MAGNETBOMB.name: Magnet Bomb
MAGNETBOMB.desc: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack will not miss.

MIRRORSHOT.name: Mirror Shot
MIRRORSHOT.desc: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target's accuracy.

SONICBOOM.name: Sonic Boom
SONICBOOM.desc: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

SPARK.name: Spark
SPARK.desc: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

TRIATTACK.name: Tri Attack
TRIATTACK.desc: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.

ZAPCANNON.name: Zap Cannon
ZAPCANNON.desc: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

CONVERSION.name: Conversion
CONVERSION.desc: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.

CONVERSION2.name: Conversion 2
CONVERSION2.desc: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.

SHARPEN.name: Sharpen
SHARPEN.desc: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.

KINGSSHIELD.name: King's Shield
KINGSSHIELD.desc: Protects itself from damage. It also harshly lowers the Attack of attackers that make contact.

POWERTRICK.name: Power Trick
POWERTRICK.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

SACREDSWORD.name: Sacred Sword
SACREDSWORD.desc: The user attacks by slicing with its long horns. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage.

BULKUP.name: Bulk Up
BULKUP.desc: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

CHIPAWAY.name: Chip Away
CHIPAWAY.desc: Seeking an opening, the user strikes continually. The foe's stat changes don't affect the damage.

COUNTER.name: Counter
COUNTER.desc: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

PLAYROUGH.name: Play Rough
PLAYROUGH.desc: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

PUNISHMENT.name: Punishment
PUNISHMENT.desc: This attack's power increases the more the target has powered up with stat changes.

QUASH.name: Quash
QUASH.desc: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

SLACKOFF.name: Slack Off
SLACKOFF.desc: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.

CAPTIVATE.name: Captivate
CAPTIVATE.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target is charmed into harshly lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

FEATHERDANCE.name: Feather Dance
FEATHERDANCE.desc: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

REVELATIONDANCE.name: Revelation Dance
REVELATIONDANCE.desc: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.

TEETERDANCE.name: Teeter Dance
TEETERDANCE.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

FORESTSCURSE.name: Forest's Curse
FORESTSCURSE.desc: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.

HORNLEECH.name: Horn Leech
HORNLEECH.desc: The user drains the foe's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by half the damage inflicted.

LEECHSEED.name: Leech Seed
LEECHSEED.desc: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

WOODHAMMER.name: Wood Hammer
WOODHAMMER.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

CRAFTYSHIELD.name: Crafty Shield
CRAFTYSHIELD.desc: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power.

EXTRASENSORY.name: Extrasensory
EXTRASENSORY.desc: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the target flinch.

HEALINGWISH.name: Healing Wish
HEALINGWISH.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

HEALPULSE.name: Heal Pulse
HEALPULSE.desc: The user emits a healing pulse which restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.

HYPNOSIS.name: Hypnosis
HYPNOSIS.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

PERISHSONG.name: Perish Song
PERISHSONG.desc: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

PSYWAVE.name: Psywave
PSYWAVE.desc: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

STOREDPOWER.name: Stored Power
STOREDPOWER.desc: The user attacks with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the damage.

WRAP.name: Wrap
WRAP.desc: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

CRABHAMMER.name: Crabhammer
CRABHAMMER.desc: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

DOUBLEHIT.name: Double Hit
DOUBLEHIT.desc: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

GUILLOTINE.name: Guillotine
GUILLOTINE.desc: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.

RAZORSHELL.name: Razor Shell
RAZORSHELL.desc: The user cuts the foe with sharp shells. It may also lower the target's Defense stat.

SNARL.name: Snarl
SNARL.desc: The user yells as if it is ranting about something, making the target's Sp. Atk stat decrease.

VICEGRIP.name: Vice Grip
VICEGRIP.desc: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

FAKETEARS.name: Fake Tears
FAKETEARS.desc: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

PLAYNICE.name: Play Nice
PLAYNICE.desc: The user and target become friends. The target loses its will to fight, lowering its Attack stat.

SCARYFACE.name: Scary Face
SCARYFACE.desc: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly reduce its Speed stat.

FIRESPIN.name: Fire Spin
FIRESPIN.desc: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

SMOKESCREEN.name: Smokescreen
SMOKESCREEN.desc: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the target's accuracy.

BLASTBURN.name: Blast Burn
BLASTBURN.desc: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.

FIREPLEDGE.name: Fire Pledge
FIREPLEDGE.desc: A column of fire hits opposing Pokémon. When used with its Grass equivalent, it makes a sea of fire.

HOWL.name: Howl
HOWL.desc: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.

LUCKYCHANT.name: Lucky Chant
LUCKYCHANT.desc: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

MYSTICALFIRE.name: Mystical Fire
MYSTICALFIRE.desc: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

SWITCHEROO.name: Switcheroo
SWITCHEROO.desc: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
